name: Shinpu-sama kara Shiboritoru!
source:
A special ritual is held once a month at a certain church.
It requires the priest's sacred bodily fluids—commonly known as the holy fluid.
The player (male) is chosen to assist in the ritual, and is tasked with helping to extract the priest's holy fluid...!?
